create_Vocabulary: create a Vocabulary with integer token count or explicit token list and optional name
create_DiscreteDomain: create a DiscreteDomain from per-position Vocabularies with unique names
build_DiscreteDomain_from_shared_vocab: build a DiscreteDomain of given length sharing a single vocabulary across all positions
build_DiscreteDomain_from_vocab_sizes: build a DiscreteDomain from a sequence of integer vocab sizes
test_DiscreteDomain_sample_uniformly: test the DiscreteDomain sample_uniformly method to generate random sequences
